newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

SOUTH KOREA, Nov 6 - Busan - one hundred and fifty-three vessels in port, 62 at berth and 91 at anchorage, berthing delay usually two to three days. Ulsan - one hundred and ten vessels in port, 70 at berth and 40 at anchorage, berthing delay usually one to two days. Pohang - thirty-one vessels in port, 27 at berth and four at anchorage, no delay. Inchon - sixty-seven vessels in port, 49 at berth and 18 at anchorage, berthing delay usually one to two days.
